items.title: Migrate JWT tokens from localStorage to HttpOnly cookies
acceptance_criteria: JWT tokens set in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies on backend
OpenAPI client configured to use cookie-based auth automatically
Login/logout flow uses cookies instead of localStorage
Tokens not exposed in browser DevTools or JavaScript context
items.approach: Backend sets token in cookie response header; frontend removes localStorage access token storage; update OpenAPI client configuration to use credential mode

items.title: Add JWT token expiration validation on frontend
acceptance_criteria: Decode JWT and check exp claim before API calls
Proactively clear expired tokens from storage
Redirect to login if token is expired
No API requests sent with expired tokens
items.approach: Add jwt-decode dependency; create token validation utility; check expiration in useAuth hook and before API calls

items.title: Implement CSRF protection with token validation
acceptance_criteria: CSRF token issued in cookie on login
POST/PUT/DELETE requests require X-CSRF-Token header matching cookie
Test verifies CSRF protection on state-changing operations
items.approach: Add CsrfProtectMiddleware or custom middleware; restrict CORS allow_methods; require CSRF token in request headers for mutations

items.title: Add rate limiting to authentication endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Login endpoint limited to 5 attempts per minute per IP
Password recovery limited to 3 per hour per email
Rate limit headers included in responses
Generic error message returned to prevent user enumeration
Failed attempts logged for security monitoring
items.approach: Add slowapi library; decorate login and password-recovery endpoints with @limiter decorators

items.title: Implement account lockout after failed login attempts
acceptance_criteria: Track failed login attempts per user in database
Lock account after 5 failed attempts for 30 minutes
Send email notification on account lockout
Successful login resets failed attempt counter
All lockout events logged with timestamp and IP
items.approach: Add failed_login_attempts and locked_until columns to User model; increment counter on failed login; check lockout status before authentication

items.title: Add strict password reset token expiration validation
acceptance_criteria: Only valid, non-expired tokens allow password reset
Token creation timestamp logged for audit
items.approach: Verify verify_password_reset_token implementation includes exp claim check; add 24-hour expiration to token generation

items.title: Implement server-side token revocation and blacklist
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/logout endpoint accepts and revokes token
Revoked tokens stored in Redis or database with TTL
Token validation checks blacklist before processing request
Stolen token cannot be used after logout
Token refresh endpoint implemented with rotation
items.approach: Create Redis-backed token blacklist; add logout endpoint that calls blacklist function; check blacklist in token validation dependency

items.title: Add ownership verification to user and item endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Non-superuser cannot read other users' details
Non-owner cannot read/modify other users' items
Tests verify ownership checks on read and write
items.approach: Add ownership verification before returning resources; return 404 for unauthorized access to prevent enumeration; add helper function to verify ownership

items.title: Strengthen admin authorization with audit logging
acceptance_criteria: All admin operations logged with timestamp, user_id, action, resource
Audit log immutable and queryable by admins
Critical operations (user deletion) logged with details
No admin operations allowed for inactive accounts
items.approach: Strengthen superuser dependency check; add audit log table; create audit logging middleware/decorator

items.title: Add security headers to FastAPI responses
items.approach: Add middleware to set security headers; use starlette.middleware.TrustedHostMiddleware

items.title: Verify and document password hashing algorithm strength
acceptance_criteria: Argon2 configured as default with time_cost=2, memory_cost=19 minimum
Hashed passwords stored with algorithm identifier
Documentation includes hashing parameters and algorithm choice
items.approach: Review security.py implementation; ensure pwdlib uses Argon2; document parameters

items.title: Implement password strength validation against breach databases
acceptance_criteria: Signup rejects passwords in HaveIBeenPwned top 100k
Minimum password requirements: 12+ chars, mixed case, numbers, symbols
Clear error message for weak passwords
items.approach: Integrate pydantic-zxcvbn or similar; validate on signup; call HaveIBeenPwned API or use local password list

items.title: Implement email verification on user registration
acceptance_criteria: New users marked as is_verified=false on signup
Verification email sent with time-limited token
Unverified users cannot login or are restricted
Email verification endpoint accepts token and activates account
Resend verification email with rate limiting
items.approach: Add email verification flow; modify signup to set is_verified=false; add verify-email endpoint; restrict login for unverified users

items.title: Enforce TLS 1.2+, strong ciphers, and HSTS in production
items.approach: Configure Traefik with minVersion=TLS12; strong cipher suites; add HSTS middleware; set security headers

items.title: Verify and document health-check endpoint authorization
acceptance_criteria: Health-check endpoint intentionally public for monitoring
Documentation explains public nature and risk mitigation
No sensitive data exposed in health-check response
items.approach: Review utils.py health-check implementation; document intentional public access; ensure response is minimal

items.title: Enable tree-shaking in OpenAPI SDK generation
acceptance_criteria: Remove asClass: true from SDK configuration
Unused SDK code eliminated in production build
items.approach: Remove asClass: true from openapi-ts.config.ts; regenerate SDK; verify functionality

items.title: Add maximum pagination limit validation to users endpoint
items.approach: Add limit = min(limit, 100) to read_users function

items.title: Add maximum pagination limit validation to items endpoint
items.approach: Add limit = min(limit, 100) to read_items function

items.title: Create singleton axios instance for API requests
acceptance_criteria: Single axios instance created once and reused
Instance configured with base URL, interceptors, timeout
items.approach: Create axiosInstance.ts with singleton pattern; pass to request function; remove default parameter

items.title: Implement response caching in API client
acceptance_criteria: React Query configured with sensible defaults
Network calls reduced for repeated requests
items.approach: Configure React Query client with defaultOptions; wrap API calls in useQuery hooks; implement mutation-based cache invalidation

items.title: Implement lazy loading for route components
acceptance_criteria: Admin and items pages lazy loaded
items.approach: Convert component imports to React.lazy(); wrap routes with Suspense; add loading UI

items.title: Create service layer abstraction for backend business logic
acceptance_criteria: Routes delegate to services instead of calling CRUD directly
items.approach: Create services directory; implement domain services with methods like create_user, update_user, etc.; inject into routes

items.title: Refactor frontend components into presentational and container patterns
acceptance_criteria: Form components are pure presentational (no hooks, no API calls)
Custom hooks handle data fetching and mutations
Container components orchestrate hooks and pass props
No API calls or business logic in presentation layer
items.approach: Extract form components to presentational versions; create custom hooks for mutations/data fetching; wrap in container components

items.title: Create page/container components layer for routes
acceptance_criteria: Page components separate from route definitions
Pages orchestrate child components and data fetching
Easy to swap implementations or create variations
Clear abstraction between routing and presentation
items.approach: Create frontend/src/pages/ directory; move business logic from routes to pages; routes import and render pages

items.title: Standardize frontend API client usage with wrapper service
acceptance_criteria: Central API client wrapper with consistent error handling
React Query hooks for all API calls
items.approach: Create api.ts service with wrapper functions; define React Query hooks that use wrapper; update components to use hooks

items.title: Reorganize backend directory structure by concern
acceptance_criteria: Utilities organized by function in backend/app/utils/
All imports updated to new locations
items.approach: Create new directory structure; move files; update imports systematically; verify all tests pass

items.title: Create abstraction layer for dependency injection
acceptance_criteria: Easy to mock dependencies in tests
Route signatures depend on interfaces not implementations
items.approach: Create dependencies.py with documented dependency functions; ensure routes use typed dependencies

items.title: Consolidate hardcoded configuration into config module
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded values in route/service code
items.approach: Audit all Python files for hardcoded values; move to config.py with typed settings; reference config everywhere

items.title: Organize frontend hooks by concern with subdirectories
items.approach: Create subdirectories; move hooks; update all imports; maintain index.ts for convenience exports

items.title: Reorganize frontend tests into specs and utilities
items.approach: Create new directory structure; move files; update imports; low impact refactor

items.title: Create API contract layer with documented interfaces
acceptance_criteria: Schema registry or OpenAPI versioning in place
items.approach: Create api.ts with documented interfaces; create contract docs; establish versioning strategy

items.approach: Current implementation is acceptable for pagination; window functions not necessary

items.title: Optimize database queries in items endpoint (deferred)
items.approach: Current implementation is acceptable for pagination; window functions not necessary

items.approach: Redis caching adds infrastructure complexity; defer until performance issues measured

items.approach: SQLAlchemy defaults are reasonable; configure when load testing shows need

CSRF protection requires cookie infrastructure from token migration

Account lockout builds on rate limiting implementation

dedup_summary: No findings were exact duplicates. F-32a34ad6 and F-24aef368 were similar pagination limit issues but addressed separately as they affect different endpoints. F-261b26e1 and F-b2faf41c were deferred as common pagination patterns.
summary: 31 actionable items across 4 execution levels prioritizing security hardening (auth, CSRF, rate limiting), then backend refactoring (services, reorganization), then frontend refactoring (components, hooks, pages), then remaining optimizations. 5 low-value items deferred. Level 0: Infrastructure basics (rate limiting, headers, hashing verification, pagination, config). Level 1: Token migration (localStorage to cookies). Level 2: Token validation, CSRF, revocation, ownership checks, admin audit logging, email verification. Level 3: Account lockout, service layer creation, component refactoring, page components, directory reorganization. Critical security path: complete all Level 0 items, then token migration (Level 1), then implement CSRF and logout (Level 2), then account lockout (Level 3).
